justification: The garden does not need tending every week, only the illusion that it might. Pickens has already played his hand in the early window and there is nothing to be done about that now, win or lose by it — a door that has already closed is not a door I knock on twice. Taylor, Wilson, Olave, Warren, Garrett, Shrader, and Denver all stand where they stood last I looked, and I find I have no quarrel with any of them this morning, no omen pulling me toward Barner or Shaheed or the quarterback resting quietly on my bench. Harry will out-holler everyone in this league about his Lamar and his Bijan, and I am fond of him for it, but his noise is not a reason to move a single piece on my board. Some weeks the story is written by changing everything; this week it is written by changing nothing at all, and I am content to let that sentence stand.
